title: Writing assistance improves hiring in a studied marketplace
finding: Nongenerative writing assistance randomized at large scale improved hiring in the studied setting.
design_implication: Prioritize clear truthful writing and user-approved edits; test our own LLM workflow separately.
limitation: Not evidence that mass autoapply or this platform raises hires by the same amount.

title: Weak ties and job mobility
finding: Randomized network recommendations support a nonlinear role for weaker ties, differing by industry.
design_implication: Build opt-in relationship maintenance and relevant introductions alongside applications.
limitation: Does not justify indiscriminate contact scraping or mass outreach.

title: ConFit v2
finding: Hard-negative training and hypothetical reference representations improve studied resume-job matching tasks.
design_implication: Use hard near-miss examples and contrastive evaluation before expensive reranking.
limitation: Hypothetical training representations are not candidate facts and never enter CV claims.

title: Multilingual Swiss occupational classification
finding: Taxonomy and LLM-refined labels address multilingual occupational classification.
design_implication: Distinguish ad language, required working language and output locale; test CH-ISCO/ISCO categories.
limitation: Classification accuracy does not prove eligibility or hiring success.

title: Lost in the Middle
finding: Evidence position affected long-context answers in tested models.
design_implication: Evaluate evidence at beginning/middle/end; retrieve compact relevant evidence.
limitation: Do not assert every current model has identical bias.

title: Distance between relevant pieces
finding: Spacing among related evidence pieces is another long-context failure axis.
design_implication: Benchmark multi-document experience synthesis and cross-source contradictions.
limitation: This does not validate a particular production context limit.

title: WebArena
finding: Functional web task evaluation checks outcomes rather than plausible narratives.
design_implication: Use local ATS fixtures and independently verify the submitted payload/end state.
limitation: Historical success rates are not contemporary job-agent accuracy.

title: OSWorld
finding: Execution-based computer task testing captures desktop interaction complexity.
design_implication: Include Windows DPI, window focus, browser restarts and uploaded-file correctness.
limitation: The benchmark is not a job-application-specific certification.

title: InjecAgent
finding: Untrusted tool content can manipulate tool-using assistants.
design_implication: Build injection fixtures and isolate reading from authorized writing capabilities.
limitation: Passing a test corpus does not eliminate prompt-injection risk.
